title: Canonical workload profiles, kernel selection matrix, and CI perf gates for runtime
creator: Ethan Liu
description: Scope: Build a practical, low-noise benchmarking harness iteration that produces repeatable golden baselines and CI perf gates focusing on kernel selection, attention microbenchmarks, and prefill/decode scheduling. The goal is to have a canonical workload suite + tooling so model/kernel changes and scheduler tweaks are validated automatically before landing, with clear diagnostics when regressions happen. This ticket covers: 1) workload taxonomy and synthetic 'golden traffic' generator that mirrors production request distributions (prompt lengths, batch sizes, model families); 2) kernel selection matrix and exporter that reports which kernels are chosen per workload cell; 3) attention microbenchmarks (different attention implementations and fused ops) with prefill vs decode timing breakdowns; 4) integration with CI to run a tight set of gates (latency p50/p95/p99 and throughput) and fail PRs with reproducible diffs and artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A canonical workload suite covering at least: decoder-only (GPT-like) and encoder-decoder families, quantized and fp16 variants, and sequence lengths {128,512,2048}
A2: Harness produces golden baseline artifacts (metrics, kernel-selection matrix, perf traces) uploaded to S3 and a perf dashboard URL on successful runs
A3: CI gate action integrated with PR checks that runs a subset of workloads and fails on: >3% median latency regression or >5% throughput regression versus golden baseline
A4: Bench runs are stable: coefficient of variation <5% for p50 across repeated runs after warmup; documentation lists recommended warmup protocol
A5: Failure artifact includes: failing workload id, kernel matrix snapshot, perf flame/trace link, and suggested rollbacks or mitigation hints
A6: End-to-end runtime for CI subset <= 30 minutes and full nightly suite completes in <= 3 hours on the perf cluster
tasks: Design canonical workload taxonomy and generate seed traffic distributions (prompt length histograms, batching mix, model families)
Extend perf harness to record kernel selection per cell and export matrix as CSV + heatmap PNG
Implement attention microbenchmarks instrumenting prefill vs decode paths with fine-grained timers
Add deterministic warmup step and RNG seeding to reduce variance; document warmup count and token patterns
Wire golden baseline storage and retrieval (S3 path convention) and a baseline diff tool that outputs human-readable delta
Create GH Action + workflow to run CI subset; implement gating rules and failure artifact uploads
Smoke test on dedicated perf cluster; iterate thresholds based on empirical noise profiles
Add dashboard widgets in perf-dashboard for kernel-switch frequency and per-workload p99 trends
